notes.subject: 2026/future provider opportunity - Bingen Huckleberry Festival
notes.body: 2026 Huckleberry Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Daubenspeck Park in Bingen WA. Official site lists bingenhuckleberryfestival@gmail.com and 509-493-3607. The event already promotes children's activities and family entertainment, so outreach should not assume they need to replace anyone. Instead, ask whether they still have room or a need this year and explain the prepaid model clearly: the event pays the package fee and guests can enjoy the attractions at no charge. If 2026 is already set, ask to be considered for 2027 or another future event. Washington is weather-restricted, not on hold, so prepaid should be the primary model. Pay-for-play can remain a secondary option if appropriate. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this Bingen event.

followUps.label: Bingen 2026/future follow-up
followUps.reason: If there is still room in 2026, lead with prepaid so guests play free; if this year is set, keep the conversation open for 2027/future events. Do not write off 2026 unless the organizer says it is closed.
